protocol.selection: Validation accuracy and disgust recall must both strictly exceed raw baseline; macro F1 and disgust F1 cannot decrease; maximize .5accuracy+.3macroF1+.2disgustF1. No test data used.
protocol.method: v5 zero-initialized residual spatial refinement of60-channel24x24features. Retain all fusion/attention/pooling paths. Training sampling mixture70%natural/30%uniform; exact train-prior correction folded into output bias at export. No teacher, no synthetic face data. Frozen old BN; new branch BN learned.
protocol.test: At most one frozen validation-qualified candidate; same all6561historically inspected test records. Integration requires accuracy, macro F1 and disgust F1 increase, disgust recall not decrease. Report precision regressions explicitly; seven-floor precision gate not imposed for this prospectively declared recall-priority run. These repeated experiments are exploratory, not fresh confirmatory evidence.
